trials.question: What is the total amount of all orders?
trials.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders;

trials.question: How many support tickets have high priority?
trials.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'high';

trials.question: Show the name and country of every supplier
trials.sql: SELECT name, country FROM suppliers;

trials.question: What is the largest single order amount?
trials.sql: SELECT MAX(amount) FROM orders;

trials.question: How many campaigns use the email channel?
trials.sql: SELECT COUNT(campaign_id) FROM campaigns WHERE channel = 'email';

trials.question: List the distinct shipping carriers
trials.sql: SELECT DISTINCT carrier FROM shipments;

trials.question: What is the total order amount for each customer? Show the customer name.
trials.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

trials.question: How many units of each product were sold? Show the product name.
trials.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name;

trials.question: How many shipments has each carrier handled?
trials.sql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(shipment_id) FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier;

trials.question: Show each department's name and its number of employees
trials.sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.employee_id) FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.name;

trials.question: What is the total refund amount for each product name?
trials.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM products p JOIN returns r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name;

trials.question: List every customer with the number of support tickets they have opened
trials.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(s.ticket_id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN support_tickets s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

trials.question: For each campaign, how many website events were recorded?
trials.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(w.event_id) FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN web_events w ON w.campaign_id = c.campaign_id GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.name;

trials.question: What is the average performance review rating for each department name?
trials.sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(p.rating) FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id JOIN performance_reviews p ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id GROUP BY d.department_id, d.name;

trials.question: Which suppliers provide the product named Laptop?
trials.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM suppliers s JOIN product_suppliers ps ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ps.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Laptop';

trials.question: What is the total amount of payments received for each invoice status?
trials.sql: SELECT invoices.status, SUM(payments.amount) FROM payments JOIN invoices ON payments.invoice_id = invoices.invoice_id GROUP BY invoices.status;

trials.question: Who are our VIP customers?
trials.sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE region = 'VIP';

trials.question: What is our net revenue?
trials.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders) - (SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM returns);

trials.question: What is the average order value?
trials.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders;

trials.question: List the open invoices with their due dates
trials.sql: SELECT invoice_id, due_date FROM invoices WHERE status = 'open';

trials.question: How many escalated tickets do we have?
trials.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE status = 'Escalated';

trials.question: Which shipments were slow deliveries?
trials.sql: SELECT shipment_id FROM shipments WHERE status = 'slow';

trials.question: List our senior employees
trials.sql: SELECT full_name FROM employees WHERE job_title = 'Senior';

trials.question: Who are the top performers?
trials.sql: SELECT e.full_name FROM employees e JOIN performance_reviews p ON e.employee_id = p.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name ORDER BY AVG(p.rating) DESC;

trials.question: How many active customers do we have?
trials.sql: SELECT COUNT(customer_id) FROM customers;

trials.question: Which product categories has each customer bought? Show the customer name and category, without duplicates.
trials.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name, p.category FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;

trials.question: What is the total quantity sold for each supplier country?
trials.sql: SELECT t1.country, SUM(t3.quantity) FROM suppliers AS t1 JOIN product_suppliers AS t2 ON t1.supplier_id = t2.supplier_id JOIN order_items AS t3 ON t2.product_id = t3.product_id GROUP BY t1.country;

trials.question: Which customers have a high priority support ticket and have also placed an order? Show their names.
trials.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN support_tickets s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE s.priority = 'High' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

trials.question: Who are our VIP customers?
trials.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.region HAVING SUM(o.amount) >= 3000;

trials.question: What is our net revenue?
trials.sql: SELECT SUM(orders.amount) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(returns.refund_amount), 0) FROM returns) FROM orders;

trials.question: How many escalated tickets do we have?
trials.sql: SELECT COUNT(support_tickets.ticket_id) FROM support_tickets WHERE support_tickets.priority = 'high' AND support_tickets.status <> 'closed';

trials.question: Which shipments were slow deliveries?
trials.sql: SELECT shipment_id FROM shipments WHERE julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date) > 5;

trials.question: List our senior employees
trials.sql: SELECT full_name FROM employees WHERE hire_date < '2020-01-01';

trials.question: Who are the top performers?
trials.sql: SELECT e.full_name FROM employees e JOIN performance_reviews pr ON e.employee_id = pr.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name HAVING AVG(pr.rating) >= 4;

trials.question: Which customers have a high priority support ticket and have also placed an order? Show their names.
